commercialNotes: Prior portfolio data listed two revision rounds and a 14-day defect window for website tiers; application/software tiers listed a 30-day window. Confirm the definition and current terms before use.
A prior rate file suggested 50/50 milestones for websites and 40/30/30 for software. No payment schedule applies until accepted in the written proposal.
Hosting, domain renewals, APIs, payment-provider charges, licences, applicable taxes and bank fees are separate unless a written scope says otherwise.
A rush option adds 25% to the project subtotal in the prior estimate logic. Availability must be checked and accepted in writing first.
Monthly support is recurring and is never included in the one-time estimate total. The actual plan limits and cancellation terms belong in a separate support agreement.
